status: All six newly refitted and rendered. Physical surface hypothesis; figures disclose guard failures. No accepted library entry replaced.

physical_model.surface_populations: Independent intensities from three finite endings; one fraction vector shared across rods and parent phases.
physical_model.ordered_samples: Same sites, occupancies, ADPs, repeat count and normalization. Whole-cell shifts alter only finite boundaries.
physical_model.mixed_pbi2: Same stochastic parent laws and initial orientation; N+1 layer states, partial endpoints, complete interior, exactly3N atoms, division byN.
physical_model.geometry: Same physical azimuth symmetry, spherical mosaic measure, source distribution, Cu doublet, optics, detector response and fixed measured background.
physical_model.fitted: Mosaic sigma/gamma/eta, common scale, shared surface fractions, existing parent fractions.

direct_squared_magnitude.scope: 8192 actual signed hkl queries per material, all phase laws and surface windows; both wavelengths and deep minima.

proof.ordered_bragg: Integer-L strengths preserved within1e-11 relative; this statement does not apply to disordered endpoint-sensitive Pb reflections.
proof.convergence: q4 native full profiles and full saved source averages. Angular-bank compression checked. Source-specific fold and broader quadrature qualification remain pending.
proof.rejected_optimization: Exact finite-lag polynomial agreed with centered moments; only1.05–1.20x isolated SF speedup, so not used.

fit_selection: Orange plotted trial minimizes the joint shape/density/count objective. Separate guarded candidate must preserve every frozen comparison metric.

b4_low_angle_counterfactual.conclusion: Wider Gaussian mosaic dominates the low-angle regression. Termination-specific stitch and fitted common scale both reduce it.
b4_low_angle_counterfactual.stitch_original_recompile: Exactly equal to archived baseline; SF(0), critical Q and blend bounds unchanged.
b4_low_angle_counterfactual.provenance: Read-only counterfactual contractions of the actual complete B4 source bank; rounded reporting values.

limitations: Termination fractions are fit parameters, not independent evidence of actual surface chemistry.
No strict all-peak improvement is implied when the plotted trial fails guards.
Comparison baseline is freshly replayed at the same q4 quadrature, not the separately refined Te archive.
Weaker peaks outside the frozen selected peak windows are checked through their full branch, not individually.

external_runtime_dependencies.role: Validated input reconstruction and stochastic parent phase laws.
